name: 笑脸 smiley-tread road tire

origin.basis: Innova Rubber Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 in Changhua, Taiwan (retailer company profile).

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Low-cost folding road tire with a smiley-face tread and colour edges, sold widely in China.
weight_basis: One owner reported 240 g for a 28C.

community.summary: Rolled well for the price and fitted by hand, but had the least grip of five budget tires and a thin sidewall.

availability.note: Sold in mainland China by a Tmall Maxxis dealer and many Taobao shops; other regions not verified.

price_observations.market: 玛吉斯赛力专卖店 (Tmall dealer)
price_observations.conditions: Dealer list price for one pink-edge 28C tire before discounts; coupon price CNY 142.

caveats: Exact English model name and size-specific specifications were not found.
Owner grip rating was the lowest in its comparison group.
